name: app-food-ordering-curved-category-arc-held-in-dark-hands
title: Food Ordering App in Dark Hands
whatItIs: A close-up of two dark-skinned hands holding a phone with a food ordering screen: 'Hungry? Order & Eat.', a search bar, circular category thumbnails along an arc and product cards for noodles, pizza and burgers, with a dark floating nav bar.
whatItMeans: Big close-ups and a finger about to tap make the app feel immediate and appetising, while cutout food photos give it energy.
techniques: Cut-out food images with a soft shadow
Dark floating nav with an orange home button

vocabulary.definition: Round category icons arranged along a curve.
A product photo isolated from its background.
A tight crop of hands interacting with a screen.
